name: The Theramore Docks
summary: At Theramore Docks, papers taken from a ship lie beneath the water. Nazeer Bloodpike sends you to recover them after two spies were discovered and cast them into the sea.

sections.title: Papers in the Water
sections.body: After dealing with the Theramore spies, you hear from Nazeer Bloodpike again. Two spies went to a ship by the Theramore docks and took its papers. They were discovered and threw the papers into the sea. One spy escaped and reported the failure, unable to retrieve what they had cast away.

sections.title: Beneath the Docks
sections.body: The Captain's Documents lie in a footlocker beneath the water by the Theramore docks. You are sent to recover them and bring them to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village. He says the papers matter greatly to the Alliance's stability. That makes them important to the Horde's security, too.

faq.q: Who sends you to Theramore Isle?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike sends you from Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: What are you looking for beneath the docks?
aliases: what do i need to find
what item is in the water
faq.answer: You are looking for a footlocker beneath the Theramore docks. It holds the Captain's Documents.

faq.q: Why were the documents thrown into the water?
aliases: why are the papers in the ocean
how did the footlocker get there
why did the spies drop it
faq.answer: The two spies took papers from a ship at the docks, but were discovered and forced to throw them into the sea. One escaped without them.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want these documents?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike says the documents matter greatly to the Alliance's stability, and therefore to the Horde's security.

faq.q: What comes before this in the storyline?
faq.answer: It follows Theramore Spies, where you hunted the infiltrators east of Brackenwall Village.
